from pathlib import Path
import ast,json,subprocess,sys
out=Path("reports/T0008/review-r1-isolation-probe")
tree=ast.parse(Path("tests/test_derivations.py").read_text())
script=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="ISOLATION_SCRIPT" for t in n.targets))
needle='\nfor blocked in BLOCKED:\n    assert sys.modules.get(blocked) is None'
assert script.count(needle)==1
leak="\nimport types\nsys.modules['kmesh.logic.engine.review_hidden'] = types.ModuleType('kmesh.logic.engine.review_hidden')\n"
injected=script.replace(needle,leak+needle)
control=injected.replace('print("ISOLATION_OK")','assert not any(name == root or name.startswith(root + ".") for name in sys.modules for root in BLOCKED if sys.modules[name] is not None)\nprint("ISOLATION_OK")')
results={}
for name,code,expected in (("leak_before_submitted_scan",injected,0),("complete_scan_control",control,1)):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",code],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
    (out/(name+".stdout")).write_text(p.stdout)
    (out/(name+".stderr")).write_text(p.stderr)
    assert p.returncode==expected,(name,p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
    results[name]={"exit_code":p.returncode}
results["correction"]="Earlier review-r1/probe.py injected the leak after the final scan; that isolation subprobe was insufficient. This new run injects before the submitted scan, with an exhaustive-scan control. Oracle and matching mutations from the earlier run remain valid."
(out/"findings.json").write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
